landing.hero_title: School management families love and the office team appreciates.
landing.hero_sub: Streamline logistics, communicate in real time and stay fiscally compliant. The perfect complement to your current system.
landing.hero_note: Video demos and on-site visits by appointment for schools in Angola and Portugal (Lusophone).
landing.mock_fee_paid_body: Proof validated. Receipt available in the app.
landing.mock_bus_body: Morning run: about 7 minutes to your stop.
landing.mock_footer: Push + history in one place — fewer questions for the office.
landing.legado_title: We work alongside your current software.
landing.legado_p1: Edukamba can sit next to what your school already uses. Start when it makes sense — simple imports or exports without replaying years of history in one step.
landing.legado_p2: The office keeps trusted internal processes; guardians get clearer notices and payments on their phones.
landing.legado_card_title: Keep your legacy billing while you modernise the parent experience.
landing.legado_card_body: No “big bang” migrations: start where it matters (communications, billing, transport/meals) and connect what you already run on desktop.
landing.func_title: The pillars that set Edukamba apart
landing.func_sub: Not just a module list — the day-to-day impact on the office and families.
landing.pillar_comm_b3: Less paper in the school bag
landing.pillar_log_b2: Canteen: plans and registrations with aligned billing
landing.compare_sub: Traditional vs. cloud + mobile experience built for families.
landing.compare_r1_trad: Slow flows in single front-desk queues
landing.compare_r1_edu: Responses and actions logged remotely, in real time
landing.compare_r2_edu: Cloud + mobile experience when you need agility
landing.compare_r3_trad: Paper, phone calls and queues at the office
landing.compare_r3_edu: Push, email and history in the app — less operational noise
landing.compare_r4_edu: Issuing and flows aligned with practice and fiscal integration (AGT)
landing.faq1_a: You don’t need a hard break from your current system. Edukamba is a complementary layer: start with simple imports or periodic exports and grow integration over time without stopping the office.
landing.faq2_q: Does it work without constant internet?
landing.faq2_a: The mobile app uses local caching where content was already loaded (e.g. recently viewed lists). Time-sensitive actions (payments or validations) resume when the network returns — built for real-world connectivity.
landing.faq3_a: The focus is simplicity: clear notifications and focused screens for tuition, events and transport. In most cases guardians are autonomous in minutes — the school stops being a call centre.
landing.cta2_title: Want to see Edukamba at your school?
landing.cta2_body: Book a guided demo or request a plan proposal sized to where you want to modernise first.
